preserve: Actual face shape and relative eye, nose, lip and jaw proportions
Natural skin albedo, age impression, hair identity and distinctive eyewear
ignore_source_conditions: Source room/background, color cast, expression strain and phone-lens distortion
Source-only earbuds, phone, microphone and unrelated props

anchors: Keep existing window-frame intersections and table edges at their original image coordinates
composition.placement: Example only: seated at the available right-hand seat, behind the existing table; choose a coherent head/torso scale from chair and table, not an arbitrary small face
composition.pose: Relaxed closed-mouth expression toward the taking camera; one forearm can rest naturally beside the plate
composition.outfit: Example text-only outfit: dark short-sleeved shirt with subtle pale abstract printed patches
composition.occlusion_and_crop: Table naturally occludes seated lower body. Do not shrink furniture or distort body parts to fit. Feet may be outside the frame.

scene_evidence.region: Existing table and solid interior frame
scene_evidence.observation: EXAMPLE observation: warm local highlights on table; distant exterior darker and cooler
scene_evidence.inference: EXAMPLE hypothesis: warm interior ambient contribution with weak cool exterior fill; replace after actually viewing the chosen image

unknowns: Actual room dimensions, lamp position and physical camera settings are unmeasured
This template is a worked example, not image analysis; rewrite all scene-dependent entries

direction.image_space: Broad interior fill; exact direction unknown
direction.depth: Unknown; do not invent a visible lamp

color.tendency: Weak warm contribution in the example interior
color.basis: E1 is an illustrative authored observation, not a measured color temperature

sources.apparent_size: Broad apparent reflection region; actual emitting size unknown

synthetic_lights.position: One small neutral phone LED near the taking lens, slightly above and image-right
synthetic_lights.size: Small emitter with modest lens-to-flash offset
synthetic_lights.relative_strength: Readily visible direct flash on subject while preserving existing ambient exposure
synthetic_lights.falloff: Near reachable table/hand surfaces can react more than the subject; distant exterior reacts negligibly
synthetic_lights.color_response: Neutral flash adds to the existing ambient color; it does not replace the whole scene white balance

background_light_exceptions.region: EXAMPLE reachable near table and solid chair surfaces only; revise this box after viewing the actual image
background_light_exceptions.allowed_change: Only local flash contribution and attached cast/contact shadows; distant exterior and original ambient illumination stay unchanged

unknowns: The near-axis body shadow can hide on chair/solid frame; a transparent window is not an invented opaque receiving wall

tracks.occluder: Forearm and drinking-glass base near the table

receiver.region: Real tabletop immediately beneath and behind each object

tracks.direction: Short attached projection toward lower/image-left, consistent with the slightly upper-right flash
tracks.softness: Small-source transition, finite penumbra; not a broad studio shadow
tracks.attachment: Begin at actual contact/projection geometry, never a detached copied silhouette

flash_geometry.basis_note: Placement and distance ordering are authored examples, not recovered 3D measurements
flash_geometry.receiver: Real tabletop/solid seat surfaces; far exterior excluded
distance_relations: Taking camera/flash to near table props is shorter than to seated subject
Far skyline is much farther than the interior subject; flash does not relight the skyline

depth_layers.relative_distance: Nearer to the lens than the seated torso
depth_layers.flash_response: Compact highlights where orientation permits and short attached table shadows
Coherent face, neck, arms and shirt illumination; keep local anatomical shading
No visible flash-driven exposure, color, detail or sharpness change

shadow_links.visibility_reason: Near hand/prop geometry casts onto real tabletop; body cast shadow may be hidden

specular_surfaces.region: Eyeglass lenses/frame, only if actually present on assigned subject
specular_surfaces.material: Transparent curved lenses and polished frame
specular_surfaces.orientation: Reassess from final pose; lens normals are not measured
specular_surfaces.reflection_path: F1 to the lens/frame to the taking camera only where normals support the return path
specular_surfaces.highlight_action: Small glints or narrow bands; both eyes remain readable; do not stamp matching centered dots

specular_surfaces.region: Existing clear glass and polished tableware, if visible
specular_surfaces.orientation: Curved glass and utensil surfaces vary in orientation
specular_surfaces.reflection_path: F1 to each real surface to the taking camera; response differs by material and normal
specular_surfaces.highlight_action: Compact local glints, retain transparency and material color; no blanket white paint or starbursts

facial_shadow_checks.action: Retain attached nasal/nostril shading with ambient fill

facial_shadow_checks.receiver: Skin under lip and under chin
facial_shadow_checks.action: Keep short anatomical self-shadows, not painted contour makeup

facial_shadow_checks.region: Eyeglass frame and hairline when present
facial_shadow_checks.direction: Consistent with the same near-axis F1
facial_shadow_checks.action: Fine local shadows without hiding eyes or creating a second side light

acceptance: Same assigned identity with natural skin texture; no source-only prop leakage
Original background FOV, anchor positions, ambient exposure and distant exterior remain stable
Coherent near/subject/far flash response, plausible conditional specular highlights and short attached anatomical/contact shadows
No limb collisions, detached shadows, warped tableware or invented opaque shadow receivers
